name: BioSuite Virtual: The World of Biotech
summary:
# The World of Biomanufacturing
Take your first step toward BioSuite Virtual. This short, immersive primer is not a full course on its own, but an on-ramp to hands-on biomanufacturing training. In one focused experience, it introduces the environments, concepts, terminology, and workflows used throughout BioSuite Virtual, helping the equipment and training tasks feel familiar before you begin.

# How It Prepares You for BioSuite Virtual
- Introduces the environment where your training will take place
